title: Delete account and data
subject: Re: {original_subject}
body:
Hi{from_name_greeting},

Thanks for getting in touch about deleting your account.

Ben stores your bills on your device. To remove everything from this phone, delete the Ben app. That clears local data on that device.

If you also want any server-side records we hold (such as your email-in forwarding token) removed, reply to confirm the email address you use with Ben and we will process the deletion.

There is no rush on our side — take the time you need.

Kind regards,
Ben support
